detail.longDescription: AI is getting insanely powerful — and somehow harder to use. Taku fixes the last mile. It turns the best skills, agents, and workflows into real desktop apps anyone can run, remix, and make their own. Borrow setups from the pros, skip GitHub and setup, or just tell Taku what you want and watch it assemble the stack. The more you work, the more Taku learns what you need — and brings the right tools to you.
